🎬: Frankenstein (2025)

Plot:
Victor Frankenstein (Oscar Isaac), a brilliant but arrogant scientist, becomes consumed by his obsession with conquering death. Through a forbidden experiment, he creates a living being from assembled body parts. The Creature (Jacob Elordi), abandoned by its creator and rejected by society, embarks on a tragic journey in search of identity, acceptance, and purpose. As Victor and his creation spiral toward inevitable confrontation, the film explores themes of ambition, isolation, humanity, and the devastating consequences of playing God.
